entities.summary: Tran, a notable figure in the history of Vietnam, associated with Independent Dynasties and Dai Viet (1225–1400). Preceded by Tran Dynasty and Mongol Invasions and Temple of Literature founded — one of Vietnam's first universities. Their legacy influenced Tran Hung Dao defeats three Mongol invasions and Le Loi defeats the Ming Chinese and founds the Le dynasty.
